question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dune, Bob gets Beloved, and Claire gets Middlemarch.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Claire and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Dune
(B) Beloved
(C) Middlemarch
solution:
Books in reader order: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: Dune | Beloved | Middlemarch
1. Bob ↔ Claire: Dune | Middlemarch | Beloved
2. Bob ↔ Claire: Dune | Beloved | Middlemarch
3. Claire ↔ Alice: Middlemarch | Beloved | Dune
Alice has Middlemarch, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
